verses.t: Kalata iyi yachokera kwa Paulo, Silas, ndi Timoteo. Tikulemba kwa mpingo wa ku Tesalonika, kwa inu amene muli a Mulungu Atate ndi Ambuye Yesu Khristu. Chisomo ndi mtendere zikhale ndi inu.
Nthawi yonse timayamika Mulungu chifukwa cha inu nonse, ndipo timapemphera chifukwa cha inu.

Tikakumbukirani pamaso pa Mulungu Atate wathu, timakumbukira ntchito yanu yochokera m'chikhulupiriro, zochita zanu zochokera m'chikondi, ndi kupirira kwanu kochokera m'chiyembekezo cha Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu.
Akuze ndi alongo okondedwa ndi Mulungu, tidziwa kuti Mulungu wakusankhani.
Pakuti Uthenga Wabwino wathu sunabwere kwa inu ndi mauthenga okha, koma ndi mphamvu ya Mzimu Woyera ndi kutsimikizika kwakukulu. Ndipo mukudziwa mmene tinayendera pakati panu chifukwa cha inu.
Ndipo munatsata chitsanzo chathu ndi cha Ambuye polandira uthenga ndi chimwemwe cha Mzimu Woyera ngakhale m'masautso aakulu.
Chifukwa cha ichi, munakhala chitsanzo kwa okhulupirira onse ku Girisiya, m'Makedoniya ndi ku Akaya.
Pakuti mwa inu, uthenga wa Ambuye unafalikira osati ku Makedoniya ndi ku Akaya chabe, koma chikhulupiriro chanu mwa Mulungu chinafikira m'malo onse. Choncho sitifunikira kuuza anthu chilichonse.
Pakuti anthu onse akuuza za mmene munatipokera bwino ndi mmene munasintha kuchoka kwa mafano kuti mutumikire Mulungu wamoyo ndi wa choonadi.
Ndipo akuuza mmene mukudikira Mwana wake kuchoka kumwamba, Yesu, amene Mulungu anamuukitsa kuchoka m'akufa, amene ndiye watipulumutsa ku mkwiyo wobwera.
Akuze ndi alongo, inu nokha mukudziwa kuti kubwera kwathu kwa inu sikunandera m'mabe.

Mukudziwa mmene tinazunzidwa ndi kumvetsa manyazi ku Filipi asanabwere ife kwa inu, koma Mulungu anatilimbikitsa kuyankhula Uthenga Wabwino wake kwa inu mwachilimbikitso ngakhale m'chikangano chachikulu.
Pakuti ulalikiri wathu sunachokera kuchinyengo kapena zolinga zonyansa kapena chidzipulikitso.

M'malo mwake, timayankhula monga otumizidwa ndi Mulungu ndi wokhazikitsidwa kulandira Uthenga Wabwino. Cholinga chathu ndi kukondweretsa Mulungu, osati anthu, chifukwa iye akayeza maganizo m'mitima yathu.
Kale sitinanena mauthenga onyengerera, monga mukudziwa. Ndipo Mulungu ndi mboni kuti sitinanama ngati abwenzi anu kuti tipeze chuma chanu.
Sitinafune kutamandidwa ndi anthu, kaya kwa inu kapena kwa ena.
Ngakhale monga atumwi a Khristu tingakakamizeni zinazake, m'malo mwake tinali ofatsa pakati panu, monga mayi amasamalira ana awo okha.
Tinakukondani kwambiri, choncho tinagawana ndi inu osati Uthenga Wabwino wa Mulungu chabe, koma miyoyo yathu nayo, popeza inu munakhala okondedwa kwambiri kwa ife.
Akuze ndi alongo, mukumbukira ntchito yathu ndi kulemetsa kwathu. Usiku ndi usana tinagwira ntchito kuti tisakhalire mligo wa wina aliyense polalikira Uthenga Wabwino wa Mulungu kwa inu.
Inu nokha ndinu mboni, ndipo Mulungu nalinso, mmene tinayendera ndi uyeru ndi chowona ndi kukhala opanda cholakwa pakati pa inu okhulupirira.
Ndipo mukudziwa kuti tinathandiza aliyense mwa inu monga mmene abambo amathandiza ana awo.
Tinakomba aliyense wa inu, tinamuimba mtima, ndipo tinamukomba kuti akhale molingana ndi mmene Mulungu ayenera kuona inu, chifukwa iye anakuitanani ku ufumu wake ndi ulemerero.

Choncho, nthawi yonse timayamika Mulungu kuti munalandira uthenga umene munalandira kwa ife, simunalandire ngati mauthenga a anthu, koma monga umene uli kwenikweni, Mawu a Mulungu, amene akuchita ntchito mwa inu okhulupirira.

Akuze ndi alongo, munatsata chitsanzo cha mipingo ya Mulungu mu Yudeya yomwe ili mwa Khristu Yesu. Pakuti inu munakumana ndi mazunzo kuchokera kwa anthu anu nokha monga iwo anakumana ndi mazunzo kuchokera kwa aYuda,
amene anapha aneneri ndi Ambuye Yesu, ndipo anazunzanso ife. Sanakondweretsa Mulungu ndipo amenyera anthu onse,
pokatiletsera kulalikira chipulumutso kwa aAmuni. Mwanjira imeneyi akuchulukitsa machimo awo. Koma mkwiyo wa Mulungu wafika pa iwo potsiriza.
Akuze ndi alongo, tatapatulidwa kwa inu kwa kanthawi pang'ono, m'thupi osati m'mtima. Tinayesetsa kwambiri kubwera kwa inu m'kukhumba kwakukulu.
Tinafuna kwambiri kubwera kwa inu, ine Paulo ndinayesanso kawiri ndi kawiri, koma Satana anatiletsa.
Pakuti chiyembekezo chathu ndi chimwemwe, ndipo tauzo la kudzitama kwathu pa Ambuye wathu Yesu akabwera, ndinu inu!
Inde, inu ndinu ulemerero wathu ndi chimwemwe.
Choncho posatha kupirira, tinasankha kukhala tokha ku Atene,

ndipo tinatuma Timoteo kwa inu. Iye ndi m'bale wathu ndi wogwira ntchito pamodzi ndi Mulungu polalikira Uthenga Wabwino wa Khristu. Tinamtumira kuti akulimbikitseni ndi kukuimbirani mtima m'chikhulupiriro chanu,
kuti wina asagwedeze chifukwa cha mavuto amenewo. Inu nokha mukudziwa kuti takonzedwa kukumana ndi izi.
Ngakhale tinalipo ndi inu, tinakuuza kuti mavuto adzabwera, ndipo inachitika monga mmene mukudziwa.
Choncho posatha kupirira, ndinatuma Timoteo kukaona ngati chikhulupiriro chanu chinali cholimba. Ndinachita mantha kuti woyesayesa angathe kukupusitsani ndipo ntchito yathu ingakhale imabe.

Koma tsopano Timoteo wabwera kuchokera kwa inu ndi uthenga wabwino wa chikhulupiriro ndi chikondi chanu. Akuuza kuti mukumakumbukira kufikira kwathu ndi chimwemwe, ndipo mukufuna kutioneranso monga ife tikunufuna kuonani.
Choncho, akuze ndi alongo, pa mavuto ndi masautso athu, tinalimbikitsidwa kwambiri chifukwa cha chikhulupiriro chanu cholimba.
Tsopano tikukhala ndi moyo watsopano ngati mukuyimirira molimba mwa Ambuye.
Kodi tiyamike Mulungu bwanji pa chimwemwe chonse chimene ife tili nacho pamaso pa Mulungu wathu chifukwa cha inu?
Usiku ndi usana timapemphera mwachidukulu kuti tidzaoneranso ndi kuchotsa mipata ya chikhulupiriro chanu.
Mulungu Atate wathu mwini ndi Ambuye wathu Yesu atitengeni kwa inu msanga.
Ndipo Ambuye akuchulukitseni chikondi pa wina ndi m'modzi ndi kwa anthu onse, monga mmene ife timakukondani,
kuti mitima yanu ikhazikike ndi kukhala oyera ndi opanda cholakwa pamaso pa Mulungu Atate wathu, Ambuye wathu Yesu atabwera ndi anthu ake oyera onse. Ameni.
Potsiriza, akuze ndi alongo, tikukombani m'dzina la Ambuye Yesu kuti mukhale molingana ndi mmene tinakuphunzitsani kuti mukondweretse Mulungu, monga mmene muyendabe. Tikulombani kupitilizabe motero.
Pakuti mukudziwa malangizo amene tinakupatsa mwa ulamuliro wa Ambuye Yesu.
Chifuniro cha Mulungu ndi ichi: mukhale oyera. Musachite chiwerewere.
Ndipo aliyense wa inu azisunga thupi lake m'uyeru ndi ulemu,
osati m'chisiriro monga amapagani amene samudziwa Mulungu,
ndipo wina asachitire mwano kapena kupusitisa m'bale wake pa nkhani izi, pakuti Ambuye ndiye woweruza machimo amenewo onse, monga mmene tinakuuza ndi kutsimikizira kale.
Pakuti Mulungu anakuitanani kukhala oyera, osati moyo wonyansa.
Choncho, amene akana izi sakana maphunziro a anthu koma akana Mulungu amene akupatsani Mzimu wake Woyera.
Tsopano pa chikondi cha abale, sitifunikira kukulemba pa nkhani iyi, chifukwa Mulungu mwini anakuphunzitsani kukondana.
Inde, mukuona chikondi ichi kwa okhulupirira onse ku Makedoniya yonse. Komatu, akuze ndi alongo, tikulombani kupitiliza kuona chikondi ichi koposa.
Yesani kukhala opita bata, musamalire zanu, nagwire ntchito ndi manja anu, monga mmene tinakuuza.
Motero anthu amene sali okhulupirira adzakulemekeza, ndipo simudzadalira ena.
Akuze ndi alongo, sitifuna kuti musadziwe za amene agona m'tulo, kuti musadandaulire monga iwo amene alibe chiyembekezo.
Pakuti ngati tikhulupirira kuti Yesu anamwalira naukitsidwa, chimomwecho Mulungu adzabweretsa pamodzi ndi iye iwo amene agona m'tulo mwa Yesu.
Tikuuza ichi monga Mawu a Ambuye: Ife amene tikukhala mpaka Ambuye atabwera sitidzawadutsa iwo amene agona m'tulo.
Pakuti Ambuye mwini adzatsika kuchoka kumwamba ndi mau a ulamuliro, ndi mau a mkulu wa angelo, ndi malipenga a Mulungu. Ndipo iwo amene anafa mwa Khristu adzauka oyamba.
Kenaka ife amene tikukhala ndi kutsalira padziko titengedwa pamodzi nawo m'mitambo kukakumana ndi Ambuye m'mlengalenga. Ndipo tidzakhala ndi Ambuye nthawi yonse.
Choncho limbikitsanani ndi mauthenga amenewo.
Tsopano pa nthawi ndi nyengo, akuze ndi alongo, sitifunikira kukulembera.
Pakuti mukudziwa bwino kuti tsiku la kubwera kwa Ambuye lidzabwera mosakhumirika ngati mbanda usiku.
Anthu akamati, 'Mtendere ndi chikhazikiko,' tsoka lidzawagwa mwachangu monga ululu wa kubereka kwa mkazi woyemba, ndipo sadzapeza njira yothawira.
Koma inu, akuze ndi alongo, simuli m'mdima kuti tsiku limenelo lidzakudusyeni ngati mbanda.
Pakuti nonse ndinu ana a kuwunika ndi ana a usana. Sitili a mdima kapena a usiku.
Choncho tisagone monga ena, koma khalani odzuka ndi ozindikirika.
Pakuti iwo ogona, amagona usiku, ndipo oledzera amaledzerako usiku.
Koma ife a kuwunika, tikhale ozindikirika, tivale zida za chikhulupiriro ndi chikondi, ndipo titenga chipulumutso ngati chisoti cha nkhondo.
Pakuti Mulungu sanasankhire ife mkwiyo, koma chipulumutso mwa Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu,
amene anamwalira chifukwa cha ife, kuti kaya tigona kapena tiri odzuka, tikhale naye limodzi.
Choncho limbikitsanani ndi kumangizana, monga mmene mukuchitabe.
Akuze ndi alongo, tikulombani kuti mulemekeze iwo amene akugwira ntchito pakati panu ndi akutsogolera ndi kukuphunzitsani m'dzina la Ambuye.
Awalemekezerani kwambiri ndi chikondi chachikulu chifukwa cha ntchito yawo. Khalani m'mtendere wina ndi m'modzi.
Akuze ndi alongo, tikulombani kuti muwadzudzule achipere, mulimbikitse ofooketsa mtima, musamalire ofooketsa, ndipo mukhale opirira kwa aliyense.
Samalani kuti wina asabweze choipa pa choipa, koma nthawi yonse yesani kuchita chabwino wina kwa m'modzi ndi kwa anthu onse.
Kondwerani nthawi yonse.
Musaleke kupemphera.
Yamikani m'mkhalidwe uliwonse, pakuti ichi ndi chifuniro cha Mulungu mwa Khristu Yesu pa inu.
Musazimitse Mzimu Woyera.
Musanyoze uprofeta.
Koma yezani chilichonse. Sungani chimene ndi chabwino.
Chokani ku zoipa m'mitundu yake yonse.
Tsopano Mulungu wa mtendere mwini akuyeretseni m'njira yonse, ndipo mzimu wanu ndi moyo ndi thupi zikhazikike opanda cholakwa mpaka Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu atabwera.
Amene anakuitanani ndi wokhulupirika, ndipo iye adzachita izi.
Akuze ndi alongo, pemphereraninso ife.
Perekezani moni kwa abale ndi alongo onse ndi pokonyesa kwachiyero.
Ndikuuzani m'dzina la Ambuye kuti muwerenga kalata iyi kwa abale ndi alongo onse.
Chisomo cha Ambuye wathu Yesu Khristu chikhale ndi inu.
